name: noose
title: Noose
about: A loop that draws tight when the standing part is pulled: an overhand knot tied round a bight of the standing part. The same knot as the slip knot, used as a snare. Shown loose and flat.

steps.caption: Lay the rope in a loop near its end, the standing part crossing under the end where the loop closes.
Bring a bight of the standing part up through the loop: over the near side of the loop, then under the far side.
The bight is the noose, both its legs through the first loop: over the near side, under the far side. Pull the end to tighten the knot; pull the standing part and the noose closes.
